caveats: The 1350-second outer limit is checked between phases and is not a hard wall-clock watchdog for full source/venv guards or final audit. Each phase process has a bounded wait; root should retain external observation of the actual command and terminal rc.
On a phase timeout, the process group is killed and partial outputs are retained; an interruption or failure before RESULT.json is not a complete scan and must not change the static count.
The candidate does not prove truly cold startup, Bionic runtime, device behavior, or blackbox qualification.
next: Root may issue a separately reviewed exact ROOT-RELEASE.json and one local --execute; require actual four phase rc0 plus all check booleans and independent postrun review before static count change.
scope: one exact original VLC 3.7.1 APK; host-only four-phase static inventory; no startup/blackbox/device/tool pass
